description: DataImager (plan §10.1): copy(device, destIso, sink, cancel) copies every sector of DriveControl.openRaw(device) to destIso, 512 sectors (1 MiB) at a time, and returns the bytes copied. It writes a hidden file next to destIso ('.<name>.part-…'), flushes it, and renames it to destIso only when every sector was read: a failed or cancelled copy leaves nothing behind. A chunk that can't be read is read again sector by sector, so the error names the first byte that can't be read: other.readError {offset, reason (the reader's)}. destIso already there: fs.alreadyExists {path}, before anything is read. Cancelled: job.cancelled. Progress after each chunk: ProgressValue(current = total = sectors done × 10000 / all sectors, max 10000). The fake disc: 'sectors' sectors, byte i of the disc is (i / 2048 + i) mod 256; 'unreadable' sectors fail; 'cancelAfterChunks' cancels after that many chunks are written; 'openFails' makes openRaw fail with drive.notFound. 'left' lists the destination folder afterwards.
